buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bid specific Terms & Condition 1. Availability of Office of Service Provider: The bidder must have an operational office located in Mumbai, Thane, or Navi Mumbai to ensu re effective coordination, smooth service delivery, and administrative convenience. The address of the office must be verified by the Department of Posts, and a copy of the verification mu st be uploaded along with the bid. Additionally, bidder may submit incorporation certificate, GSTN , etc for authenticity of the office address. 21.. Participation at the pre-bid meeting is mandatory. Those who fail to show up for the pr e-bid meeting on the designated day will not be considered for the bidding. The bidder must have a copy of these terms & conditions on their firm's letterhead with acceptance when they attend the pre-bid meeting. 3. Solvency Compliance: The bidder must have a solvency of minimum 50 lakh. Copy of the certificate of the concerned ban

k must be uploaded. 4. GST Compliance: Bidders are advised to independently verify the applicable GST rate before quoting. The Buyer w ill not be responsible for any discrepancies in GST classification or rate. GST reimbursement s hall be made on the basis of actuals or as per the applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to t he maximum of the quoted GST percentage. 5. Timely Salary Payment to Outsourced Resources: The L1 bidder/selected vendor must ensure payment of salaries to the outsourced resources withi n the first five working days of each month, post confirmation of attendance by the Compan y. Subsequently, the bidder may raise the claim for payment by attaching the UTR details of sa lary disbursement, along with proof of Salary slip, ESIC and PF payments. 6. Contract Extension: The duration of the service contract may be extended beyond the initial period, subject to sat isfactory performance and mutual consent between the parties. 7. Minimum Experience Requirement: The bidder must have a minimum of three years of experience (up to September 2026) in providing at least 40 outsourced Housekeeping staff and 1 Gardener to Central/State Gov ernment departments, PSUs, or Nationalised Banks within the Mumbai region. A list of suc h clients, along with the duration of services rendered, must be furnished. Relevant documents mu st be uploaded as part of the bid submission, and the Buyer reserves the right to verify the su bmitted documents. 8. Staff Addition/ Replacement: If the department requests the replacement of any staff, the service provider shall provide a suitab le replacement within 15 days of receiving such intimation. If the department requests the additio n of a new staff to the panel, the service provider shall include the new staff in the panel within 15 days of receiving such intimation. 9. Contract Termination Clause: If the services rendered by the contractor are found unsatisfactory, the contract may be terminat ed by giving one month’s notice. 10. Supply of uniforms: All outsourced resources must be provided with two pairs of uniforms, including shirt, trousers, and one pair of shoes. The cost of these items may be negotiated after the contract is finalized. Further more, no washing allowance for uniforms shall be payable by the company. 111.. Bidders are responsible for liaising with BMC regarding garbage disposal and any other matters pert aining to BMC. 12. The Agency shall provide the equipment for housekeeping. The Agency must maintain and supply this machinery continuously throughout the contract dura tion, including any approved extension periods 113.. Housekeeping materials must be provided by the selected L1 bidder. 14. Performance Security Submission: The successful bidder must submit the Performance Security in one of the following forms withi n 15 working days of generation of contract: · Account Payee Demand Draft (DD) · Electronic Performance Bank Guarantee (E-PBG) (as permitted under GeM GTC) For Demand Draft, it should be made payable to: The New India Assurance Company Limited, payable at Mumbai. The bidder must upload a scanned copy of the DD/E-PBG and ensure delivery of the phy sical copy to the Buyer (NIACL) within 15 days of award of the contract. For Online Payment, the details are as follows:
o Beneficiary Name: The New India Assurance Company Ltd. o Account No.: 00600350000323 o IFSC Code: HDFC0000060 o Bank Name: HDFC Bank o Branch Address: Fort, Mumbai .
